response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and some high-throughput backend work (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic micro-services), plus strong community teaching and open-source leadership. However, the role's core hard requirement — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; his only documented C/C++ professional work is roughly six months at National Instruments (2014-2015) plus a university thesis project. Similarly, there is no evidence of building or leading large-scale cloud compute platforms, hardware/storage architecture, or formal technical leadership of cloud/DevOps engineers. His stack is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. The mismatch on the primary technical requirements outweighs his general seniority and mentoring track record.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across many domains and stacks
Demonstrated mentoring: workshops, courses, conference talks, open-source project ownership
Real low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems exposure at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
concerns: Roughly 6 months of professional C++ vs. 8 years required
No large-scale cloud compute platform or infrastructure-ownership experience
No formal technical leadership role managing cloud/DevOps engineers or roadmaps

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform / large-scale infra ownership
Mentoring, teaching and open-source project leadership
